first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child riding Vehicle A, with neck-length brown hair, wearing a red long-sleeved top and dark blue overalls.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low tricycle ridden by Person A, with a blue high backrest, part of a red lower frame, two wide black rear wheels, and part of a metal handlebar visible.

entities.name: orange-brown geometric-patterned carpet
entities.identification: The carpet covering the visible corridor floor, with thick orange zigzag frames, dark brown areas, and red center blocks.

entities.name: interior wall
entities.identification: The light beige walls on both sides and at the end of the corridor, with vertical wall corners and dark brown baseboards.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The set of dark brown rectangular interior doors visible in the clip.

entities.name: potted plant at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: A potted plant with green branches and leaves to the left of the end door, with a terracotta-colored round pot at the bottom.

entities.name: red wall plate at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: Two vertically separated red circular plates on the wall to the left of the end door, with the upper one larger.
